name: Bayworks
long_description:
Self-driving companies record every mile a car drives. Nobody records how it gets fixed.

We capture how technicians fix cars and use it to run the dealership’s operations, making every repair faster and more consistent.

In four months, we have gone from 0 to $843K in cARR across six dealership groups, including a top-50 US group ($3Bn annual revenue), and have powered over 50,000 repairs.
one_liner: Intelligence that keeps America’s vehicles running
